scan_max.description: The most rows one `find` reads before it ranks and pages; an answer that reached it says `truncated`.

description.purpose: Answers the questions of the library -- `find` from the catalogue alone (one full-text search, ranked by the field each word hit), `symbol` and `related` through one pull to the graph space plus one catalogue read for path and summary line, `tree` through one pull to the file space -- exactly one answer each, every list a page of at most 20.
description.use_when: Inside a librarian only, behind `in_lib` (from outside or from `./tools`) and the `in_pulled` answers whose `op_id` starts with `lib:g:` or `lib:f:t:`.
description.not_in_scope: No write, no content of a source, no state of its own: a question in flight rides in its own `op_id`.
description.emits_meaning: `query_store` to `./store` (at most once per question), `pull` out of the hive (graph and tree questions), `answer` once per question -- to `./tools` when `caller` is 'tools', out of the hive otherwise.
description.consumes_meaning: A question on `in_lib`, an answer of the graph or the file space on `in_pulled`, and the store's answer to its one bundle.
